question: What universal benefit follows from inserting the liṅga to three parts depth?
premises: The liṅga may be inserted to a depth of three parts.
Depth of insertion determines the fruit.
This depth produces joy for all embodied beings.
inference: When the liṅga is inserted to three parts, all embodied beings rejoice.
plain_english: But when it is inserted to three parts, all embodied beings rejoice.
